title: Jungle Totem and Goddess
description: A vibrant surreal jungle scene featuring a large green and gold carved wooden totem with spiral patterns on the left. To the right, a woman with purple hair adorned with ferns and flowers stands in profile along a winding, glowing white path that curves through the dense foliage.
